verdict.rationale: Aider explicitly supports headless/scripted use via the --message flag to run a single instruction and exit, and via a Python scripting API (Coder.create/coder.run) for programmatic automation, both documented for non-interactive/CI-style workflows. Config can also be driven via env vars/CLI flags/.aider.conf.yml, aiding automation setups. Missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions) or independent community confirmation of headless CI usage.
